description_en: Retrieves recommendation results for a specified instance
description_zh: 该接口用于获取指定实例的推荐结果
kebab_example: aliyun airec recommend --instance-id airec-test001 --scene-id test --user-id 123 --ip 192.168.1.1 --imei 06e1565409c9fc4887036b9744210000 --return-count 10 --items 1001 --service-type 1 --user-info 1 --rank-open true --rec-type gul --filter eyJqb2luIjoiYW5kIiwiZmlsdGVycyI6W3siY29uZCI6ImNvbnRhaW4iLCJmaWVsZCI6InRhZ3MiLCJ2YWx1ZSI6IuWPjOS6uiJ9XX0. --strategy fixedSlot --api-version 2020-11-26 --region cn-hangzhou
